metadata.database: A Deeper China | Guangzhou decision layer

GZM01.guest_need: A visitor wants Cantonese food explained through timing, ordering and social format.
GZM01.hidden_need: Avoid stale restaurant lists and surface dietary, queue and language friction.
GZM01.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One explained meal format reveals Guangzhou as a trading and social city better than a restaurant ranking.
GZM01.stop_condition: One safe, understood food format is complete; no food crawl.
GZM01.low_energy_branch: Keep one confirmed meal or tea context.
GZM01.rain_branch: Food remains a strong indoor branch after venue and dietary checks.
GZM01.body_cost: Low walking but high waiting, dietary and communication sensitivity.

GZM02.guest_need: A visitor wants old Guangzhou through water, trade, lanes and adaptive reuse.
GZM02.hidden_need: Choose one coherent neighbourhood story instead of disconnected heritage stops.
GZM02.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One Liwan/Xiguan sequence explains port-city life and present reuse better than another shopping street.
GZM02.stop_condition: The guest can distinguish water, trade, residential fabric and current reuse.
GZM02.low_energy_branch: Use one public walking fabric and a seated/indoor stop.
GZM02.rain_branch: Keep Shamian/covered or indoor layers and shorten open-lane movement.
GZM02.body_cost: Moderate walking with heat, humidity, crossings and crowds.

GZM03.guest_need: A visitor wants traditional Guangzhou through craft, clan and architectural language.
GZM03.hidden_need: Separate living interpretation from generic old-building photography.
GZM03.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One craft/clan anchor answers how local form was made and used; a second heritage site may dilute it.
GZM03.stop_condition: One architectural or craft language has become legible.
GZM03.low_energy_branch: Choose the indoor clan/craft anchor and stop.
GZM03.rain_branch: Strong indoor branch after opening and ticket checks.
GZM03.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking with attention and crowd load.

GZM04.guest_need: A visitor wants less manicured old Guangzhou and ordinary urban density.
GZM04.hidden_need: Keep public-space observation ethical and avoid calling a neighbourhood authentic by default.
GZM04.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One public arcade/religion sequence shows density and daily use better than a landmark checklist.
GZM04.stop_condition: The guest has understood one public-street pattern without entering private space.
GZM04.low_energy_branch: Use one short arcade/temple edge and a quiet stop.
GZM04.rain_branch: Keep covered arcades and confirmed indoor cultural space.
GZM04.body_cost: Moderate walking with humidity, crossings, commercial noise and privacy friction.

GZM05.guest_need: A visitor wants contemporary Guangzhou through river, skyline and current neighbourhood life.
GZM05.hidden_need: Decide whether skyline, night river or creative neighbourhood actually serves the brief.
GZM05.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One contemporary-city question is deeper than stacking tower viewpoints.
GZM05.stop_condition: The guest can explain one relationship between river, finance, public realm and current city life.
GZM05.low_energy_branch: Choose one public river/skyline edge and return early.
GZM05.rain_branch: Use a confirmed indoor or covered contemporary layer.
GZM05.body_cost: Moderate evening exposure with crowds, heat and return-transport uncertainty.

GZM06.guest_need: A visitor wants to understand Guangzhou as a trading city rather than simply shop.
GZM06.hidden_need: Separate public market observation from sourcing, pricing or private access promises.
GZM06.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One market decision explains wholesale, consumption and trade friction better than a mall crawl.
GZM06.stop_condition: The guest has one clear observation purpose and a safe exit.
GZM06.low_energy_branch: Use one public market edge and stop before sensory overload.
GZM06.rain_branch: Choose a covered market route after current access is checked.
GZM06.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking with crowd, language, payment and privacy sensitivity.

GZM07.guest_need: A visitor needs Guangzhou to work in humid weather and on the real arrival day.
GZM07.hidden_need: Prevent payment, metro, heat and late-return friction from ruining the route.
GZM07.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A reliable arrival/recovery layer is more valuable than adding another landmark.
GZM07.stop_condition: The visitor can pay, navigate, rest and reach the next confirmed anchor.
GZM07.low_energy_branch: Keep the route close to hotel/metro and defer outdoor density.
GZM07.rain_branch: Default wet-weather recovery branch after current opening check.
GZM07.body_cost: Low sightseeing load, high humidity and operational sensitivity.

GZM08.guest_need: A visitor needs to decide between Guangzhou–Shenzhen contrast and a Guangxi extension.
GZM08.hidden_need: Prevent a thin multi-city bundle from replacing a coherent base city.
GZM08.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A handoff is useful only when the second place adds a new question and the transfer earns its cost.
GZM08.stop_condition: The visitor has a sequence, minimum time and transport decision they accept.
GZM08.low_energy_branch: Keep Guangzhou and remove the extension.
GZM08.rain_branch: Use current rail and indoor programme conditions before changing cities.
GZM08.body_cost: Transfer fatigue and reservation order are the main costs.
